ei.subject: 6월_2026 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: The Evolution of Transport and Energy

fullPassage: The major consumer of oil is transport. But consider what has happened over the last thirty years or so to the technology involved in producing the internal combustion engine. Because oil is expensive, car engines today are far more efficient in their consumption of fuel (and far less polluting) than they were in 1972. The cars that Asia buys tomorrow will certainly not be anything like those Americans use today. Americans will not buy today's cars tomorrow either. In fact, if the price of oil does rise much further then fuel cell technology (which produces energy from water!) will receive yet another momentum. The big car multinationals have already produced the prototype motors — they are currently racing to try and get prices down and engine performances up. Their future profits depend upon it. Imagine now if there is a breakthrough in fuel cell technology. What would happen to oil prices? They would fall dramatically — signalling much less demand than supply — and oil companies and OPEC oil producers would stand to lose much income. The fact that this threat is real is driving the producers to look for alternative sources of income. The 'oil majors' have diversified and are now more energy companies than oil companies these days and the OPEC countries are urgently attempting to develop other industries.

They would fall dramatically — signalling much less demand than supply — and oil companies and OPEC oil producers would stand to lose much income. The fact that this threat is real is driving the producers to look for (C)[alternative / identical] sources of income. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:

det.tip: 석유는 비싸고(expensive), 엔진은 효율적(efficient)이며, 대체(alternative) 수입원을 찾는다

(3) He took a fall while skiing. — '넘어짐(명사)'으로 동사가 아닌 명사 용법
(4) The soldiers fall in line. — 'fall in line(줄을 서다)'은 관용표현으로 의미가 다름
det.tip: (A)의 fall = 유가가 하락하다. (2)의 fall = 기온이 내려가다. 둘 다 수치의 감소

ch: Leaves fall from the trees every autumn.
The temperature will fall below zero tonight.
He took a fall while skiing down the mountain.
The soldiers fall in line for the morning drill.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an important discovery or development that helps solve a problem or allows progress to be made"

det.analysis:
① consumption(소비): 소비를 뜻하며 발견/발전과 무관
② momentum(추진력): 진행 방향의 힘이지 발견/발전이 아님
③ breakthrough ←정답: 문제 해결이나 진보를 가능하게 하는 중요한 발견/발전
④ performance(성능): 작동 능력을 뜻하며 발견/발전과 다름
det.tip: breakthrough = 문제를 해결하거나 진보를 이루는 중요한 발견

questions.passage: Because oil is expensive, car engines today are far more efficient in their __________ (consume) of fuel (and far less polluting) than they were in 1972.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 consume을 명사형 consumption으로 변환. 'in their __ of fuel'에서 소유격(their) + 전치사(of) 사이에 명사가 필요하다.

questions.passage: The big car multinationals have already __________ (produce) the prototype motors — they are currently racing to try and get prices down and engine performances up.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 produce를 과거분사 produced로 변환. 'have already __'에서 현재완료(have + p.p.) 구문이므로 과거분사가 필요하다.

questions.passage: The major consumer of oil is transport. But consider what has happened over the last thirty years or so to the technology involved in producing the internal combustion engine. Because oil is expensive, car engines today are far more efficient in their consumption of fuel (and far less polluting) than they were in 1972. The cars that Asia buys tomorrow will certainly not be anything like those Americans use today. Americans will not buy today's cars tomorrow either. In fact, if the price of oil does rise much further then fuel cell technology (which produces energy from water!) will receive yet another momentum. The big car multinationals have already produced the prototype motors — they are currently racing to try and get prices down and engine performances up. Their future profits depend upon it. Imagine now if there is a breakthrough in fuel cell technology. What would happen to oil prices? They would fall dramatically — signalling __________ — and oil companies and OPEC oil producers would stand to lose much income. The fact that this threat is real is driving the producers to look for alternative sources of income. The 'oil majors' have diversified and are now more energy companies than oil companies these days and the OPEC countries are urgently attempting to develop other industries.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① much less demand than supply ←정답: 원문 그대로 — 유가 하락은 공급보다 수요가 훨씬 적다는 신호
② a growing need for fossil fuels(화석 연료에 대한 증가하는 필요): 연료전지 기술 돌파 시 화석 연료 수요가 증가한다는 것은 문맥에 반대
③ equal demand and supply(수요와 공급 균형): 유가 급락 문맥에 부적절
④ increasing demand over supply(공급 초과 수요 증가): 유가 하락 문맥에 반대

det.analysis:
